name: Pretty Good Privacy public encryption software
description: A personal-computer program combining public-key cryptography with other methods to protect files and messages.

impact.note: Used by a security-minded minority in several countries; it made existing cryptography available on personal computers, with a few successor standards and programs.

date.basis: Date stated by the cited source; see event scope.

events.statement: A PGP version 1.0 user guide dated 5 June 1991 describes an MS-DOS program using RSA.

evidence.supports: Guide dated 5 June 1991 describes PGP version 1.0 for MS-DOS and its use of RSA.

events.caveats: The guide’s date establishes a documented version, not the exact date of first public download.

contributions.resource: Wrote the program and documentation, as stated by the guide.
